contexts.text: Deceive men by wearing a sweet expression and speech. SE 2855.
The sweet and refined wines () = the truths of these goods.
They speak sweetly... yet are the bitterest enemies.
Those in the province of the neck of the uterus and ovaries are in the sweetest life... SE 3152. DeConj 106.

In the other life probity manifests itself by gentleness and sweetness. These qualities (in the Spirits of Jupiter) could be very clearly distinguished from the gentleness and sweetness of the good Spirits of our Earth. AC 8384.
As an offering to Jehovah = the good of love and of faith, it is said that it shall then be sweet to Jehovah (). AE 444:8.
Probity (there) manifests itself by gentleness because it fears to do harm, and by sweetness because it loves to do good.
These things cause the social intercourse between the sexes (in Heaven) to be heavenly sweetnesses themselves, which are pure.
There was heard from Heaven the sweetest singing... The sweetness of the singing was like the affection of some love flowing forth harmonically.
The chaste love of the sex... derives its sweetness from eminent but chaste potency... As the beauty of a woman... enters the mind, that love is sweet.
For the odour (of ordure) is sweet to them.
To see the sweetness of Jehovah ().
Thus enjoys the use of both in pleasantness.
